arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee 'aafaanee mim-mabtalaaka bih, wa fadhdhalanee 'alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheelaa.
translation: All praise is to Allah Who has saved me from that which He has tested you with, and has greatly preferred me over many of those He has created.
